credits_text:
From the author of Dark Nation
A Film By Richard Chandler
other_text:
Our Father
Who art in heaven,
Hallowed be Thy name.
Thy Kingdom Come.
Thy will be done
on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day
our daily bread.
And forgive us our trespasses,
As we forgive those
who trespass against us.
And lead us not
into temptation,
but deliver us
from evil.
Amen
description: A dark, atmospheric poster featuring a close-up of an intense eye and overlaid religious text, suggesting a gothic, spiritual theme.
